sample_unit: patients completing Dora R2 postoperative call

links.outcome: Unplanned management changes within two weeks after 'no concerns identified' call outcome
links.effect: Only 0.3% of patients with a 'no concerns identified' outcome required unplanned management changes within two weeks.
links.quote: Regarding safety, only 0.3% of patients required unplanned management changes within two weeks of a Dora call with a "no concerns identified" outcome.

links.outcome: Differences in call outcomes by age, gender and ethnicity
links.effect: No significant differences in call outcomes by demographic factors at 5% significance level.
links.quote: There were no significant differences in call outcomes based on demographic factors (at 5% significance level).

screen.reason: Evaluates the real-world clinical deployment of an autonomous voice conversational agent (Dora R2) for postoperative cataract follow-up calls in the NHS, but does not compare specific deployment practices/guardrails.
